Minimum vaccine efficacy needed to reach a target risk

Source: R/calculate_risk.R
find_threshold_ve.Rd

For a given R0, finds the smallest vaccine efficacy (VE) at which the interpolated breach risk is at or below target times the baseline. The risk curve is interpolated linearly between VE grid points, and the first VE at which the curve reaches the target is returned.

Usage

find_threshold_ve(r0, target = 1)

Arguments

r0

Single number. Basic reproduction number, between 1 and 10.

target

Single positive number. Acceptable risk as a multiple of the baseline. Default is 1 (same risk as the pre-Delta unvaccinated baseline).

Value

A single number: the minimum VE (rounded to 3 decimals). Returns 0 if the target is already met with no vaccination, and NA if the target is not met even at the highest modelled VE (0.9).

Examples

find_threshold_ve(r0 = 6)
#> [1] 0.504
find_threshold_ve(r0 = 6, target = 0.5)
#> [1] 0.654
find_threshold_ve(r0 = 10, target = 0.1)  # NA: not reachable
#> [1] NA
